## Server

### Fixed

- Two signed reads of the admin web API in the same second were byte-identical and the second was refused as a replay, which made a panel kick or ban that follows a roster poll fail silently. Reads are no longer single-use; writes still are. A refused call is named in the host log and the console feed with its reason.

## Client

No change; the package is rebuilt so both halves carry the same version.
